title: Assessing Gestational Age in First Trimester Pregnancies Using Ultrasound
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to assess equivalency of the transabdominal Clarius handheld wifi C3 ultrasound (which uses Bluetooth to locate the ipad Mini 5 and then uses wifi direct to show the images) to the current standard of care in Women's Hospital outpatient department the portable Zonare ZS3 in patients presenting in the first trimester of pregnancy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Presenting requesting medical or surgical abortion
2. Estimated to be under 13 weeks gestational age based on last menstrual period or time of conception, or nurses best estimate.
3. Able to provide informed consent with adult supervision of a minor or with an interpreter present

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. Unable to provide informed consent
study_population: Patients are presenting for an ultrasound prior to first trimester termination of pregnancy.
